details:
If possible, would love to have button on directly on the thumbnail for the words that lets you simply add world to either one of the existing favorite pages or new list all together.

The problem with current world list: In order to add to favorites or visit a world, you have to click on the world thumbnail in the list. Upon pressing back to return to search or world tab such as "New & Noteworthy" you are returned at the top of the list, rather than where you actually were. 

The longer you scroll down, the further likely hood of this happening increases. It has resulted in worlds no longer been found again and increases player frustration when searching for worlds, having to scroll the entire list to find the spot you were on.

As such proposal of the visit later button using the corner of the thumbnail that isn't being utilized. Pressing the button would automatically add the world to the list of "Visit later" or designated favorite slot, without forcing user to go to world details and potentially losing their search progress due the back button not returning you to correct spot.

I have included image as example for where the button would be located. Left world having the example of what I'm after, the thumbnail on the right is how the worlds currently are shown in the search.
title: Visit later/Favorite button on the thumbnail in world search page, to prevent search progress being lost..
